review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature mouth part (PROPOSED): a tapir-like short mobile snout overhanging a small mouth, with a dark nose pad and flared nostrils; curls and lengthens on shape keys.

textures.name: T_PartTrunkShort_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartTrunkShort_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the snout's end turned about 50 degrees further down over the lip
the snout 35% longer past the face

part_rules.handles_note: Both keys are on TrunkShort and TrunkShortNose with the same names; the runtime sets them together. The nose pad moves rigidly with the snout's end; the lip (TrunkShortLip) has no keys and stays put.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: a broad, slightly flattened snout about 0.11 m out of the skin, tapering and drooping over a soft lower lip tucked under its root, so the mouth reads as a crease beneath an overhang; a domed oval nose pad with two flared nostril lobes closes the end cleanly; H1_Curl turns the end down over the lip, H2_Length draws it out, the pad riding rigidly.
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: fine-grained grey skin with soft transverse folds, against a near-black glossy pebbled nose pad with two dark nostril openings.
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: neutral light shows the folds and the pad's gloss without clipping; the mouth crease reads as a shadowed line.
review_notes.gate4_godot: needs revision: orientation only, from the shared forward_cone frame (not this art). On the boar (after_boar_trunk_short.jpg) it loads, seats on the snout between the tusks and keeps its dark nose pad, but points up and forward. With the frame fix previewed (conefix_boar_trunk_short.jpg) it juts forward and droops, reading as a tapir's snout.

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
